videos.title: The GTA 6 Leaker Got 7 Years… and Walked Out Same Day 🚔 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
On Nov 23, a London court sentenced 2022 GTA 6 leaker Arion Kurtaj to seven years, but time already served in a secure hospital meant he was released on licence the same day, with a five-year ban on Discord and Telegram.

Sources: ITV News, Help Net Security, Neowin, heise online

videos.title: GTA 6 Sold 32.5 Million Copies Before Launch 💰 #gta6 #shorts
videos.description:
On Nov 20, Take-Two and Rockstar said GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies pre-release and an estimated $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales — a record across all platforms.

Sources: Take-Two/Rockstar (BusinessWire), GameSpot, Kotaku, GamesRadar
